blind.description: A stylized copper distillation still comprising a rounded copper pot still mounted on sturdy curved legs, with a curved copper swan-neck pipe extending overhead and terminating inside an open wooden condenser barrel. The barrel is bound with dark metal bands and features a small brass spigot/faucet near the base. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and continuous with hand-painted stylized metal and wood textures. Stands directly on its own legs and barrel base without an added plinth.
blind.from_above: A large round reddish-copper sphere/dome connected via a curved red-copper arched pipe to an open circular wooden bucket beneath it, with a tiny brass valve jutting out to the lower right.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 3.5 to 4 feet tall (roughly waist-to-chest height on the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 2.5 to 3 feet wide.

notes: slightly wider footprint than catalog ratio
